                  Visit

                  Find us in Pererenan

                  A place you can find and walk into. Come by any day of the week and someone shows you around.

                  Address

                  Jalan Sempol No. 26, Pererenan, Bali

                  Plus code 946Q+89 Pererenan

                  Get directions, opens in a new tab Book a free tour, opens in a new tab

                  Hours

                  • First visitFree tour any day of the week, ask on WhatsApp or at the desk
                  • What to bringA water bottle to fill here. Towel, shower and locker are provided
                  • What to wearActivewear for Perform, closed shoes recommended. Swimwear or beachwear for Recharge
                  • For a classBook in the GymMaster app or at the front desk, and be there 10 minutes early
